_comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/check-tag-hygiene.mjs. Every value is a DEFECT COUNT that must not grow. Re-measured on prod 2026-08-23 after the whole tag DQ program landed (Phases 0-5). Tighten with `node scripts/check-tag-hygiene.mjs --update` after a cleanup; never loosen a number to make CI pass.

_notes.duplicate_active_name: 9 is correct, not a backlog: the deliberate mat-* sense splits (mat-leather vs leather) excluded by 20260916110000. Growth means a real twin pair regrew.
_notes.redirect_to_non_canonical: 301s into a 404. PR #2828 fixed this class once and it has regrown to 58; recorded so the 59th is caught, not so 58 is blessed.
_notes.image_without_license: 1,193 of these are self-hosted (supabase.co, img.queer.guide) with no image_source, no image_attribution and no image_prompt — the provenance was never captured and CANNOT be recovered from the database, so this is a ratchet, not a target. See 20260921100000. Only commons_image_without_license is actionable.
_notes.image_alt_column_empty: NOT an accessibility gate. Every render path already emits alt="" when this is null (TagIndexCard, MoreLikeThisByTag, FollowedTagsFeed hardcode it; TagDetail falls back to ''), which is correct for an image whose meaning is carried by the adjacent tag name.
_notes.indexable_without_description: 869 thin public pages advertised in sitemap-tags.xml. 20260921110000 deindexes them and re-indexes on prose, after which this becomes a real zero-invariant rather than a backlog.
_notes.sensitive_without_description: Grows as the profession pipeline lands is_adult German profession tags with no description yet — not a regression introduced by the tag DQ program.
_notes.event_tag_strings_unresolved: Phase 4 scope marker. events does not use the unified tag system at all — 35,131 events carry a free-text tags[] array and unified_tag_assignments has ZERO entity_type='event' rows. 363 of 535 distinct strings resolve to no tag, German-heavy (1920er, ableismus, aidshilfe, austellung/ausstellungen, ballet/ballett). The plan estimated 40 of 80. Tracked, not fixed: reconciling needs Phase 1.3's hand-reviewed disposition at 363x the size.
_notes.merged_but_not_status_merged: 1 is community-center, deliberately NOT repaired by 20260921130000: its canonical community-center-venue is deprecated, so flipping it would 301 into a 404. The other 8 (pride, sports, lgbtq-rights, discrimination, education, queere-community, charit, jannik-sch-mann) were repaired. Growth means the invariant broke again.
